thread:
wise: Quick repro: Next starter streaming hangs if ephemeral auth rotates mid-request. Seen in workshop yesterday.

nadia: Short description?

wise: SSR page calls /api/edge -> exchange ephemeral token -> call JS client stream. If the token rotates while the model is generating, the JS SDK retry reopens the stream but sends the original Authorization header. Server ignores it and client stalls.

leo: Which SDK version in the template?

wise: @redwood/sdk@0.9.2 from templates. Vercel edge runtime. Python client behaves correctly (resolves auth each attempt).

nadia: Minimal repro from starter (edge):

```
// pages/api/stream-edge.js (edge)
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const ephemeral = await exchangeShortLived(req.cookies.sid);
  const s = await redwood.stream({ model: 'redwood/fast-13b', prompt: req.body.prompt, token: ephemeral });
  s.pipe(res);
}
```

leo: Any logs to show rotation vs retry?

wise: Yep:

```
[2026-03-26T15:04:01Z] fetched token id=tmp-A ttl=20s
[2026-03-26T15:04:19Z] rotated token id=tmp-B
[2026-03-26T15:04:20Z] sdk retry attempt=1 Authorization: Bearer tmp-A
[2026-03-26T15:04:20Z] client waiting for CHUNK_END
```

nadia: Sounds like the SDK captured headers at open time. Short-term workaround: server return a one-shot presigned URL or have client fetch a fresh token immediately before opening the stream. Not great for demos.

leo: Longer-term fix: JS SDK should accept an authCallback (function) that it calls per request and per retry to get fresh headers. Backwards compatible if string API remains supported. Example API sketch: 

```
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  apiKey: () => fetch('/api/ephemeral').then(r => r.json()).then(j => j.token)
});

// SDK should call `apiKey()` on each attempt instead of reusing a captured value
```

wise: Can we add an e2e test that simulates token rotation mid-stream and asserts the retry uses newly-resolved auth? That will prevent regressions.

nadia: Yes. I'll add a test in client repo and prototype the authCallback. If green, we patch 0.9.x and update the starter template and README.

ci-bot: CI queued for branch feat/js-apiKey-callback  3 checks.

leo: Also add a short example file in the starter like examples/edge-auth-callback.md so users can copy/paste. And update "Edge auth patterns" in README.

wise: I'll open the starter PR once client change lands and include a short note in onboarding slides. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:
